One of the important features of this set of Yongzheng walking picture is the emperor dressed peculiarly, clothing categories are rich. After the Manchus entered the country, in order to prevent the rapid assimilation of the ethnic group by the Han, the Qing government explicitly forbade the Manchus to wear Chinese clothing, while the Yongzheng emperors in the picture is mostly dressed in Chinese clothing, dressed as village workers, scribes, officials, etc.. In addition, Yongzheng also wore Mongolian, Tibetan, late Western Renaissance and neo-classical costumes. Most of the Yongzheng music pictures are comprehensive pictures of figure painting, portrait painting and landscape painting, with detailed and realistic background painting, from which the style of landscape painting and portrait painting at the Yongzheng court can be appreciated.
